    Gerbils

    To whom to I show restraint,
    Or tangle riches in the mist,
    Voices, distant from my cyst
    Rabid they may never faint

    Citizen before the pact
    Knoweth he how he must act
    Not without the quiet cheer, while dim
    Not before the Others sneer at him with sin

    Tangles, dangles wish upon a sound gall-opus
    Silence, when it glows they shan’t rope us
    Ah the imagery I must escape, do you feel the same, my trusting cape?

    Forever more unnoticed lives your flaw
    But what if Others visioned what I saw

    Medic scraped and tied your beaten drum
    Child of hazel, found in scum

    For I only am a shadow, hence I know
    Part of you, part of two
    Ravaged by a fatal blow

    A profounded history of you
    Told through fellow people too
    As amassed by criticality,
    My pen and papers; your lethality

    Lined up suspects yield us force of Spanish bulls
    Won’t be long ‘till dance their cracked out skulls
    Whether it be sons our friends will sell,
    Be it daughters of the Veln

    Spite us all, or two, you remnant Church!
    That’s until I find your treasures to besmirch
    Leader leads with simple hand,
    Undisturbed by your demand
    Feeding a momentum utterly of heaviest sand,
    Finds the path to reinvigorate our birch

    Many a demented bottomfeeder stand before us limpless, then they limp
    Kneecaps of their yesteryear cast out wider than the nation’s blimp
    You are in the way, in a time designed for giving with no disarray
    Shall there be no more vast East and tumultuous West,
    So that we can demonstrate us to ourselves from our uniquest crest?

    Highness, and you still believe we have more years to spare?
    Chance of reaching gates to India—no longer it lays bare
    Circumstantial—what is seen or is believed—stories of the wind
    Highness, you must be aware—I am prepared, for I’m thick-skinned
    —mainland turbulence expects it, you don’t care? — Time! I finally receive the game, with permission from the sage
    Here they go, the fluid tongues in which I speak,
    Every day on the first page.
    Farther than they ever, just as countless bodies’ liquids they will reek

    There is gladness to my heart, fellows’ve put a face to my own name!
    Never uninvited, not neglected—but cardinal, how go our operations?
    Good thus far, I don’t believe, I tell how it is. Have you looked at my creations…
    Highness, why you have to take away my claim?
